formCues: Tilt head gently to one side
setup: Sit or stand tall with relaxed shoulders and head in neutral position.
commonMistakes: Yanking the head with hand
Shrugging shoulder up to meet ear
Holding breath

setup: Stand with feet together, knees slightly bent, ready to bound laterally.
commonMistakes: Bending knees too much like a squat
Landing flat-footed
Traveling too far each hop

setup: Attach harness or handle to sled, stand sideways to direction of travel in athletic stance.
commonMistakes: Standing too upright
Crossing feet instead of stepping
Rushing the tempo

setup: Stand sideways on the stepmill holding the side rail lightly for balance.
commonMistakes: Leaning heavily on rails
Taking steps too small
Twisting the torso excessively

setup: Stand sideways next to a box or bench with one foot placed on top.
commonMistakes: Pushing off the ground leg
Letting the knee cave inward
Leaning torso forward

formCues: Lean away from the cable stack
setup: Stand sideways to a low cable pulley, grip handle, and lean the torso away from the machine.
commonMistakes: Standing upright instead of leaning
Using momentum to swing the arm
Shrugging the shoulder up

formCues: Brace on a rack or post
Lean torso away from working arm
setup: Hold onto a stable post with one hand, lean sideways, and hold a dumbbell in the other hand.
commonMistakes: Not leaning enough to isolate the delt
Swinging the weight up with momentum
Rotating the torso

setup: Sit in the leg extension machine with shins behind the pad and back against the seat.
commonMistakes: Using momentum to kick the weight up
Not completing full range of motion
Gripping the handles to cheat the lift

setup: Sit in the leg press machine with back flat against the pad and feet on the platform.
commonMistakes: Letting knees cave inward
Lowering too far and rounding lower back
Locking out knees aggressively

formCues: Place toes on lower edge of platform
Get a full stretch at bottom
setup: Sit in the leg press machine with only the balls of the feet on the platform, legs mostly extended.
commonMistakes: Bending knees during the raise
Using too short a range of motion
Bouncing at the bottom

formCues: Keep legs still and off the rope
setup: Hang from a suspended rope with legs lifted off the ground and away from the rope.
commonMistakes: Using legs to assist the climb
Swinging body for momentum
Descending too fast and losing grip

setup: From a lunge position, place hands inside the front foot and lower onto forearms if able.
commonMistakes: Letting front knee collapse inward
Rounding the lower back
Forcing depth too quickly

formCues: Hinge and grip the log handles
Explode to bring log to chest
setup: Stand over the log with feet hip-width, grip the neutral handles, and set the hips back.
commonMistakes: Rounding the back during the clean
Pressing without leg drive
Catching the log too low on the chest

setup: Clean the log to shoulder height and stand tall with feet hip-width apart.
commonMistakes: Using a leg dip to cheat the press
Leaning back excessively
Flaring elbows too wide

setup: Hold the log at shoulder height with feet shoulder-width apart, knees soft.
commonMistakes: Dipping too deep and losing tightness
Pressing before the drive completes
Letting the log drift forward

formCues: Keep arms in line with ears
setup: Lie on the back with arms extended straight overhead and knees bent.
commonMistakes: Pulling with the arms instead of the abs
Using momentum to jerk up
Letting lower back arch

formCues: Keep body in a straight line
setup: Start in a forearm plank, then walk the elbows forward beyond the shoulders.
commonMistakes: Letting hips sag toward the floor
Piking the hips up too high
Elbows too far forward to control

setup: Sit in the leg press machine with feet positioned low on the platform, closer to the bottom edge.
commonMistakes: Heels lifting off the platform
Excessive knee travel over toes
Shortening range of motion

setup: Step one foot forward into a deep lunge with the back knee lowered toward the floor.
commonMistakes: Letting front knee travel past toes excessively
Rounding the lower back
Not extending the back hip fully

setup: Stand between low cable pulleys, grip handles, and step forward into a staggered stance.
commonMistakes: Bending elbows too much and turning it into a press
Using momentum instead of chest contraction
Standing too far forward or back

formCues: Lie on side on a bench
setup: Lie on one side on a flat bench with the bottom arm supporting the head and top arm holding a dumbbell.
commonMistakes: Rocking the torso to generate momentum
Raising the arm too high past shoulder level
Using too heavy a weight

formCues: Keep hips flat on the floor
Keep knee straight but not locked
setup: Lie on the back with a strap looped around one foot and the other leg extended flat on the floor.
commonMistakes: Lifting opposite hip off the floor
Bending the working knee to fake range
Pulling too aggressively into pain

formCues: Lie flat with hands at sides
setup: Lie on the back with legs extended and hands flat on the floor for stability.
commonMistakes: Using momentum to swing the legs
Letting lower back arch off the floor
Not controlling the lowering phase

formCues: Lie face down on the pad
Keep hips pressed into the bench
setup: Lie prone on the leg curl machine with the ankle pad positioned just above the heels.
commonMistakes: Lifting hips off the pad
Using momentum to jerk the weight up
Not completing full range of motion

setup: Lie on the back with legs straight and hands under the glutes or flat on the floor.
commonMistakes: Bending the knees to cheat the range
Letting the lower back arch off the floor
Dropping the legs too fast

formCues: Grab top ankle and pull heel to glute
setup: Lie on one side with legs stacked, supporting the head with the bottom arm.
commonMistakes: Letting the hip rotate open
Pulling the knee forward instead of the ankle back
Arching the lower back excessively

formCues: Lie face down on incline bench
setup: Lie prone on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand hanging straight down.
commonMistakes: Using momentum to swing the weights up
Raising arms too high toward the head
Shrugging traps instead of using rear delts

setup: Lie on the back with arms extended out to the sides and legs raised to vertical.
commonMistakes: Letting shoulders lift off the floor
Using momentum instead of controlled rotation
Not engaging the core throughout

formCues: Set seat so handles align with chest
setup: Sit in the machine with back against the pad and hands gripping the handles at chest level.
commonMistakes: Seat height set too high or low
Bouncing the weight stack
Flaring elbows excessively

formCues: Align hip pivot with the machine
setup: Sit in the machine with chest against the pad and hands gripping the handles.
commonMistakes: Pulling with the arms instead of the abs
Using momentum to rock the weight
Not controlling the return

setup: Sit at the machine with upper arms resting on the pad and hands gripping the handles.
commonMistakes: Lifting elbows off the pad
Using momentum to swing the weight
Cutting the range of motion short

formCues: Get a deep stretch at bottom
setup: Bend forward at the hips into the machine with the hip pad resting on the lower back and balls of feet on the platform.
commonMistakes: Using knee bend to cheat the movement
Bouncing out of the bottom stretch
Shortening the range of motion

setup: Sit or stand at the machine with elbow bent 90 degrees and pinned against a pad.
commonMistakes: Letting the elbow drift away from the body
Using too much weight and losing control
Rushing the eccentric

formCues: Raise arms forward to shoulder height
setup: Sit or stand facing the machine with hands gripping the handles at hip height.
commonMistakes: Raising arms above shoulder height
Using momentum to swing up
Shrugging shoulders during the raise

setup: Stand facing the machine with one foot on the platform and hands gripping the handles for support.
commonMistakes: Overextending the lower back to gain range
Using momentum instead of glute contraction
Not fully controlling the return

formCues: Set seat to align handles with upper chest
setup: Sit at the machine with chest against the pad and hands gripping the high handles.
commonMistakes: Using momentum to yank the weight
Shrugging shoulders during the pull
Not retracting the shoulder blades

setup: Sit in the machine with knees against the pads and back flat against the seat.
commonMistakes: Leaning torso forward to cheat the range
Using momentum to bounce the pads open
Not controlling the return phase

setup: Sit in the machine with knees against the pads set in the open position and back flat against the seat.
commonMistakes: Using momentum instead of a controlled squeeze
Letting the pads snap open on the return
Leaning forward during the movement

setup: Sit in the machine with the pad positioned across the hips and feet flat on the platform.
commonMistakes: Hyperextending the lower back at the top
Pushing through the toes instead of heels
Using a short range of motion

setup: Sit or stand at the machine with elbow bent 90 degrees and pinned against a pad.
commonMistakes: Letting the elbow drift from the torso
Using excessive weight and losing form
Rushing through the range
